objective: Find and slay a Thunderhawk, return its wings to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.

description: The thunderhawk, <name>, is a fierce beast.  It is time for you to face them.  You must find where it roams, and bring me its wings as proof of your successful hunt.
Do this, and your time with me will near its end.
progress: Is it done? Have you slain the thunderhawk?
completion: You, like the thunderhawk, should be proud. You have bested every foe we set you before, and have done so with strength, courage and honor.
But your path, <name>, continues. In fact, you will find that true hunters forever strive, forever walk their path with the same pride you have shown me.
Now, it is time to move on.
